description: "replication of <organism>" word order. BIOLOGICAL only covers "<organism> replication", so virology abstracts phrased "the replication of enteroviruses" passed the filter — one duplicated cluster of these accounted for 106 of the 501 rows Stage 3 later screened out as not-a-replication. Up to three filler words are allowed before the organism ("Replication of Oncolytic Herpes Simplex Virus"). cell/cellular/parasite are split out and must be the HEAD of the phrase — followed by punctuation, end, or a preposition/verb. They have common non-biological collocations, and with a three-word filler window the unrestricted form killed genuine replications outright: "a direct replication of the classic CELL PHONE driving study" and "a conceptual replication of the PARASITE STRESS theory of values" both became false_positive, which is terminal. The unambiguous organism terms need no such restriction. The filler window also refuses study-nouns, so "a replication of the original STUDY in cells" keeps its real head ("study") and survives. Without that, a replication merely CONDUCTED in biological material was excluded. #147 (BO1): genome(s)/genomic no longer match inside genome-wide, so "Replication of Genome-Wide Association Studies of Type 2 Diabetes Susceptibility in Japan" survives. That clause was doing almost no protective work — 2 of 300 BIOLOGICAL_OF firings in 5.6M rows were the GWAS genre, and both were genuine GWAS-locus replications — while killing 24 gold positives of that genre. The maintainer's scope ruling (#147 §4) admits independent replications of published genetic associations and excludes two-stage discovery-plus-own-replication-cohort designs; BO1 recovers 20 papers of which 17 qualify, 1 is internal, 2 unclear, and 0 are virology. The genome arm is split out because the exemption is expressed WITHOUT a lookahead: the character after the organism token is consumed rather than looked ahead at, so both backends read it identically, and the Unicode dash range matters because several of the gold rows write "Genome‐Wide" with U+2010. SHADOW (unchanged by #147, and for a different reason): the original refuses study-nouns inside the three-word filler with a negative lookahead, which RE2 cannot express; dropping it widens the discard ('replication of the original study of DNA repair' would now match). The cell/cellular/parasite head restriction IS preserved faithfully by consuming what the original looked ahead at. keyword_verdict() keeps the exact original via pyre_regex, which carries BO1 as its own lookahead so Stage 1 and the engine agree on the change. Loaded back into keyword_verdict() as pattern id BIOLOGICAL_OF (filter/phrase_detection.py).

measured.rationale: One duplicated virology cluster phrased 'the replication of <organism>' accounted for 106 of the 501 rows Stage 3 later screened out as not-a-replication — the measurement that motivated the pattern. It says nothing about the widened RE2 form, which is why this spec is shadow.

measured.sample: 5.6M OpenAlex snapshot rows (22 parquet partitions of the 2,446-file manifest, complete harvest of the 3,785 exclusion-firing Stage A survivors) scored against the 7,505-paper override_positives.json gold corpus and the 1,333-paper gold-negative set; scope classification of the 59 affected genetics papers in analysis/stage_b_eval/gwas_scope_classification.md. Branch analysis/stage-b-eval, #144 evidence pass. Provenance caveat (#151): 4,681 of the 7,505 gold positives (62%) are `allrep_llm` — the old pipeline's own LLM verdicts, never human-confirmed — so the gold-recall figure is an upper bound. That audit matters here specifically: all 14 gold rows that fail FLoRA's own coding rule in the genetics slice came from `allrep_llm`, none from the human-curated buckets.
measured.rationale: #147 BO1: exempting genome-wide recovers 20 gold positives (17 qualifying under the internal-replication rule, 1 internal, 2 unclear, 0 molecular) and admits 2 gold negatives, at 0.4 extra rows per million scanned — 0.02% of admitted volume, ~204 rows over the full 510M-row snapshot, and both sampled influx rows are themselves GWAS-locus replication papers. The spec stays shadow because the study-noun lookahead is still undecomposable; BO1 does not change that.
